headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red; smallcaps showed resilience amid volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following CAS while Nifty 50 managed a 75-point gain.
Tighter scrutiny on H-1B visas under a new order impacted sentiment for major Indian IT firms.
NTPC terminated a ₹413 crore BESS contract due to contractor failure to meet obligations.
Mixed global cues and focus on upcoming FII activity influenced the last trading session.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday.
Paytm remained in focus following opening trends and broader market volatility.
Investors are analyzing the impact of mandatory Aadhaar biometric authentication for LPG refills.
Smallcap stocks displayed strength despite the Sensex closing in negative territory.
summary: On the last trading day, the Nifty 50 rose 75 points while the Sensex ended in the red. Sentiment was affected by new H-1B visa restrictions and NTPC's termination of a significant energy storage contract. Markets remain closed for the weekend and will resume on Tuesday, September 22.
